name: What maintenance is required for hardwood floors?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for hardwood floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining hardwood floors involves regular cleaning and protective measures to preserve their beauty and longevity. Daily or weekly care includes sweeping, vacuuming with a soft brush attachment, or dust mopping to remove dirt and grit. Use cleaning products specifically designed for hardwood floors, avoiding harsh chemicals or excessive water. Placing rugs in high-traffic areas and using furniture pads can prevent scratches. Periodic professional cleaning and re-finishing, when necessary, will keep your floors looking new.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain hardwood floors with regular sweeping, vacuuming, and specific cleaning products. Use rugs and furniture pads to prevent scratches.
